title: vulneraria lotoides
intro: Vulneraria lotoides, commonly known as False Pimpernel or Mountain Carrot, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Vulneraria lotoides include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, making it a potential treatment for infections and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Vulneraria lotoides include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
